nodes.label: Vite + React + TypeScript PWA (no SSR)
nodes.rationale: Full desktop replacement (D-02, D-03); offline and installable

nodes.label: VITE_DS_SERVER_URL env var
nodes.rationale: Defaults to same origin: web deployed on one domain with the API

nodes.label: Service worker server-path bypass (serverPaths.ts)
nodes.rationale: Otherwise OAuth consent page for agents would open as the app

nodes.label: Collapsible pen palette (useUi.penPaletteCollapsed, showPalette=false)
nodes.rationale: Same as iOS; editor itself unchanged

nodes.label: Service worker cache-first of shell and /assets
nodes.rationale: Some networks hang on TLS handshakes; after first visit reload downloads nothing

nodes.label: boot-guard.js (reload once, then Retry screen)
nodes.rationale: CSP forbids inline scripts, hence separate file

nodes.label: REST API client (api/client.ts) with timeouts and GET retries
nodes.rationale: Writes are not retried: they already sit in the ops queue

nodes.label: Boot screen and launch animation (#ds-boot, boot-anim.js, bootReady)
Sync and diagnostics settings (DiagnosticsSection, diagnostics.ts)
nodes.rationale: Report contains only codes, doc ids and times — no secrets

nodes.label: Saved session restore() with storage timeouts
nodes.rationale: Embedded in-app browsers can hang IndexedDB forever

nodes.label: Security headers / CSP (securityHeaders.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single source checked against Caddyfile by unit test

nodes.label: KDF bounds check from prelogin (kdfBounds.ts, isSafeKdf)
Attachment MIME whitelist (safeMime.ts)
nodes.rationale: Decrypted blob: lives on our origin, so only safe types open in tab; SVG stored as PNG

nodes.label: Guest session (/s/:shareId#k=)
nodes.rationale: Key after # never reaches server; removed from address bar, kept in sessionStorage

nodes.label: Revoked device wipes its data (wipeRevokedDevice)
nodes.rationale: D-53: only an explicit device_revoked signal triggers wipe

nodes.label: endKeepingData: sign-out keeping unsent data
nodes.rationale: Plain 401 unauthorized is not revocation — data kept

nodes.label: Multi-tab session with Web Locks token refresh
nodes.rationale: Server treats reused refresh token as theft and revokes device

nodes.label: Recovery key flow (confirm optional, rotate, security log)
Unsaved edits tail on pagehide (ds.unsaved, applyTail)
nodes.rationale: Two loss paths: IndexedDB tx aborted on unload, or edit stored but not queued

nodes.label: Web key storage (master key in memory, wrapped notebook keys)
Stored-docs mode (Y.Doc only for open notes)
nodes.rationale: 10 000 notes: 2 live docs instead of 10 003, heap 72 MB vs 139 MB

nodes.label: Sync status indicator (Not sent: N, Retry)
reconcileNotebooks / canonical server notebook key
nodes.rationale: Device could keep its own notebook key after a 409; two devices then couldn't read each other

nodes.label: Pause document until key available (keyAvailable)
nodes.rationale: Previously skipped forever: moved note opened empty

nodes.label: glyph.ts SF Symbol to emoji mapping
syncNotebookMetaCopy
nodes.rationale: Server cannot see account doc; agents and consent screen need names

nodes.label: maintainOwnedShares owner key distribution and rotation
Density D-61 (rows by default, compact sidebar with counters)
Version history with authors and diff
Minimal vs extended mode flag (VITE_DS_EXTENDED_MODE, D-51)
nodes.rationale: Extended code kept and built, hidden by flag; minimal build never writes tab/daily data

nodes.label: Empty fresh note deletion (isNoteEmpty, freshNotes)
nodes.rationale: Notes from elsewhere may only look empty before data arrives

nodes.label: Editor waits for note content (useNoteContentReady)
nodes.rationale: Editor on empty doc wrote its own title, demoting the real one (2026-10-26 loss)

nodes.label: Images and files in note (uploadAttachment, fetchRemoteImage)
fetchRemoteImage via POST /fetch-image (D-52)
nodes.rationale: CSP stays connect-src 'self'
